stories.title: How will data centers impact Michigan’s renewable energy goals? It’s complicated, new research says
stories.summary: New research indicates that Michigan's data center growth, including facilities in Saline and Van Buren Townships, complicates the state's 2035 renewable energy goals. While data centers may fund new renewable generation and storage, their substantial energy demand could necessitate increased reliance on natural gas and challenge utilities' ability to meet targets without delays, requiring significant land for solar expansion.

inputFacts.title: How will data centers impact Michigan’s renewable energy goals? It’s complicated, new research says
inputFacts.summary: A new research brief from the Citizens Research Council of Michigan examines how the rapid growth of hyperscale data centers may complicate the state's ability to meet its 2035 renewable energy goals. While data centers provide funding for new renewable projects, their massive electricity demand could necessitate increased reliance on natural gas and create significant infrastructure and land-use challenges for utilities.

stories.title: Work stops on Google data center project after Wayne County says it lacks permit
stories.summary: Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for Google's "Project Cannoli" data center in Van Buren Township, citing a lack of proper county construction permits and potential impacts on county drains. The developer, Panattoni, is accused of working within easement areas and obstructing drains, creating flood risks. The project is expected to require significant power, equivalent to a city's electricity needs.

inputFacts.title: Irving Berlin’s Holiday Inn
inputFacts.summary: Encore Musical Theatre Company opens Irving Berlin’s Holiday Inn on Nov. 27, featuring classic Irving Berlin songs and heartwarming romance. The production runs through early January at 7714 Ann Arbor St., Dexter.

inputFacts.title: Small Business Saturday jumpstarts Ann Arbor’s economy heading into the holidays
inputFacts.summary: Small Business Saturday is highlighted as a significant economic driver for local brick-and-mortar stores in Ann Arbor as the holiday season begins. Chad Wiebesick of Destination Ann Arbor emphasizes that shopping locally keeps a majority of spending within the community, supporting both employees and independent businesses.

inputFacts.title: Are you registered to vote in Michigan? Here's how to check ahead of November general election
inputFacts.summary: The 2026 November general election sample ballot can be viewed through the Michigan Voter Information Center. Voters may cast split tickets or choose straight-ticket options for partisan races, though straight-ticket selections do not automatically include non-partisan races.

inputFacts.title: Cinema Chat: "Paper Tiger" opens and special holiday screenings are on the way
inputFacts.summary: Mat Hopson and Tara Calligan discuss new movie releases for the Thanksgiving weekend and upcoming holiday season screenings. They provide insights into what audiences can expect at the cinema.

inputFacts.title: Club Kid
inputFacts.summary: Actor and comedian Jordan Firstman makes his directorial debut with the A24 comedy-drama 'Club Kid'. The film follows a nightlife promoter who unexpectedly becomes a father.

inputFacts.title: Rewriting Michigan’s constitution?: Understanding Proposal 1 on the November 2026 ballot
inputFacts.summary: Proposal 1 on Michigan's 2026 November ballot asks voters whether to convene a constitutional convention in 2027 to draft a general revision of the state constitution for voter approval or rejection. The proposal will appear as 'Proposal 2026-1: A proposal to convene a constitutional convention for the purpose of drafting a general revision of the state constitution' on the ballot.

inputFacts.title: Wild Horse Nine
inputFacts.summary: Directed by Martin McDonagh, 'Wild Horse Nine' is a dark espionage thriller set in 1973 Chile. The film stars John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell as CIA agents on a mysterious assignment on Easter Island.

inputFacts.title: You Can See Everything
inputFacts.summary: This documentary follows disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes in the final days before her imprisonment. The film captures a three-year journey into the life of the Silicon Valley figure.
